description: Implement applicative_order_step and reduce_applicative to contract the leftmost, innermost redex by reducing arguments before applying functions.

steps.description: In applicative_order_step(term), when term is an App, recursively step term.func and then term.arg before checking whether the outer App itself is a redex.
Only after neither term.func nor term.arg can step, check is_redex(term) on line 15 and call beta_step(term).

steps.answer: Because lines 11-13 run before the is_redex(term) check on line 15, it steps the inner redex inside M first.
steps.question: If term is a redex (λx. e) M where the argument M also contains a redex, what does applicative_order_step reduce first?

steps.description: If term is a Lam node, recursively step term.body, or return (term, False) when no inner redex remains.
Define reduce_applicative(term, max_steps, trace) to repeatedly apply applicative_order_step until stepped is False or max_steps is reached.

title: Applicative-Order Reduction Strategy
